what_each_new_part_touches: Each 7-hole beam first gets a pin in its middle hole (yellow box, 4x), then the beam is pressed onto the base at one of four marked spots.
where_everything_is_after: four 7-hole cross beams span the base

why.problem_solved: Ties the left and right sides together so the base can't spread.
why.why_these_parts: Short pins in the middle hole of a 7-hole beam centre it on the spot; four of them make the frame rigid.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 7 onward builds the turntable seat on top of these.

review_note: Where exactly the four cross beams land on the base is shown by the two black arrows; their pin holes are not countable in the picture.
